The '''LNR Series II Systemary Laser Battery''' was a planetary [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] model used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was the successor of the [[LNR Series I Systemary Laser Battery|LNR series I]].

==Description==
The LNR Series II consisted of a two cannons situated on a tower. This model was not as well-protected as the LNR series I, but much more powerful and slightly less expensive to maintain.
